title: Private network orchestration setup wizard frames
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Design a compact, operator-focused onboarding wizard for Private/VPC deployments that covers preflight checks, network validation, bootstrap (operator/CLI assisted), and upgrade/rollback preview screens. Deliver Figma frames, annotated screenshots for docs, and a set of small-screen responsive variants for the Console quickstart.
progress_updates: 2026-02-28: Kickoff meeting with PM (Lena Cho) and Eng (Ravi Patel). Aligned on edge operator + VPC quickstart paths and requirement for offline bootstrap flow.
2026-03-03: First-pass wireframes delivered. Feedback: reduce cognitive load on 'Network details' step and add inline 'what this checks' microcopy.
2026-03-07: Visual design round 1 completed. Created desktop and mobile variants; started export slice naming convention for docs team.
2026-03-11: Engineering review — request to include CLI command copy button and sample exit codes for bootstrap failures.
2026-03-14: Accessibility pass started; contrast adjustments applied to status chips and form labels.
review_comments: PM Lena Cho: Please surface estimated time-to-bootstrap for both online and offline flows on the first step.
Eng Ravi Patel: For the offline appliance flow include a clear retry strategy and a link to the operator logs (k8s logs snippet).
Security Samir Khan: Add note about KMS key provisioning step and a link to compliance checklist in upgrade modal.
Docs Eva Müller: Need 3 copy-ready screenshot sizes (small/medium/large) and annotations called out as plain-text for the docs pipeline.
decisions: Use progressive disclosure: show only required network inputs initially, with an "Advanced network options" drawer for NAT/firewall specifics.
Show a preflight 'Network Sanity' modal that runs lightweight checks and returns quick pass/warn/fail states before bootstrap.
Include an inline CLI terminal mock with copy-to-clipboard for the bootstrap command and a single-step 'simulate' button for demos.
Upgrade modal will show a timeline with canary percentage selector and a one-click rollback preview that describes impact in plain language.
Design to match Console tokens and color palette; use compact status chips for constrained screens.
acceptance_criteria: Figma frames for all wizard steps (desktop + mobile) uploaded to project file and linked from this ticket.
Three annotated screenshots exported at sizes: 800px, 1200px, 1600px and delivered to docs Drive folder.
Upgrade modal mock includes canary selector, timeline, and rollback preview state with copy for PM sign-off.
Accessibility contrast and keyboard focus states documented and verified by internal a11y checklist.
Exported assets follow naming convention and are referenced in PR to docs repo.
next_steps: Finalize copy for time-to-bootstrap estimators and add to the hero step (owner: PM).
Wrap up accessibility pass and request a11y review signoff from Samir.
Create PR with exported assets to docs repo and tag docs owner (Eva Müller) for integration.
Hand off Figma file to engineering for implementation notes and component tokens.
